summary: A game, not an instrument: a spoon-feeding balance game where you steer a bean on a spoon into a grumpy face's mouth, with recorded voice lines and an ambient soundtrack.
features: Keys roll, move and tip the spoon; GLO loads a bean
Thirteen voice recordings react to hits and misses
Transformation scene on every fifth successful feed
Installed with a Python USB-MIDI tool from the source archive
Optional macOS viewer and recorder follow the real device over USB
